test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

The officer informed his boss that his men were leaving the next day by plane.

options.text: The officer said to his boss, “His men were leaving the next day by plane.”
The officer said to his boss, “Your men were leaving tomorrow by plane.”
The officer said to his boss, “His men are leaving the next day by plane.”
The officer said to his boss, “My men are leaving tomorrow by plane.”

solution:
The correct answer is **The officer said to his boss, “My men are leaving tomorrow by plane.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The notion of the given sentence is 'information'. It will be changed into** 'said to'. **(**Indirect to direct**)
 
• **'his'** will be changed into 'my' because in **'direct to indirect'** speech the **first person pronoun** is changed according to the **subject** of the **reporting verb.**
 
• **'were leaving'** will be changed into **'are leaving'.**
 
• **'the next day'** will be changed into** 'tomorrow'.**

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The officer said to his boss, “My men are leaving tomorrow by plane.”*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य **Indirect speech** में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे **Direct speech **में बदलना होगा।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की **notion** '**information**' है। इसे** 'said to'** में बदल दिया जाएगा। (अप्रत्यक्ष से प्रत्यक्ष)
 
• **'his' **को '**my**' में बदल दिया जाएगा क्योंकि **'direct to indirect' speech **में **reporting verb** के **subject** के अनुसार **first person pronoun **बदल दिया जाता है।
 
• **'were leaving' **को **'are leaving' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• **'**the next day**'** को** 'tomorrow' **में बदल दिया जाएगा।
